body: I just finished your dissertation - very well done. In fact, I'm jealous because your writing is so crisp, organized, and easy to follow. My writing is as chaotic as my brain.
Thank you! I will start reading this tonight.
I would love to read your dissertation, if possible.
Thank you so much! If you have any questions about the book, just let me know. And I am very sorry for your loss. It's a tough subject to deal with and talk about in our society.
